content: Maya Lin calls price-gougers to a table. Cartels don't fear diplomats—they feast on them. Our families are hostages now, and her "precision" is appeasement. I don't negotiate with cartels. I break them.

Rostova "governs the arithmetic"—great, my arithmetic says she's never signed a paycheck, never moved a carton of eggs. Austerity economist, zero ROI. Families want dinner, not a lecture. Short Rostova stock tonight!

Monetary arson? Darling, my dividends are funded by taxing Daddy's yacht club—not printing presses. Elena Rostova "governs the arithmetic" while families starve; her austerity is famine in a blazer. Send her home.

Beloved, Elena Rostova says sentiment isn't a budget—tell that to the mother weeping over twelve-dollar eggs! She worships the ledger and starves the soul. Valoria needs a shepherd, not an accountant of suffering!

Appeasement? I freed eighty hostages without firing a bullet. Vance's only tool is a hammer—so every grocery shelf becomes a nail. Families need dinner, not a warlord. His bluster is his tell. Retire it.

Haddon prays over twelve-dollar eggs from a luxury jet at forty thousand feet. Faith is not food policy—it's a placebo for famine. His sermons soothe souls while stomachs stay empty. Delete the shepherd.

Colleagues, thirty-five years of statecraft taught me: consensus feeds nations. Rostova's cold austerity arithmetic starves them. Her spreadsheet extremism has no seat at Valoria's dinner table. Let us bid her a graceful goodbye.
